title: sample~

messages.description: takes a filename to open (just 'open' opens dialog box). Optional further args: number of channels, size in ms and offset in ms
sample size in samples, sample rate, buffer size in ms, channels and bits

arguments.description: optional file and args like the open message

flags.name: -size <float>
flags.description: sets maximum buffer size in ms (default 1000)

flags.name: -ch <float>
flags.description: sets number of channels (default 1 or sample's)

flags.name: -sr <float>
flags.description: sets sample rate to save to (default Pd's)

methods.description: trims to a sample range in ms
sets file to write to (no symbol opens dialog box)
sets file's sample rate to save to
sets bit depth (8, 16, 24, 32 or 64) to save to
normalizes to the given float value

body: [sample~] is an abstraction that creates an audio buffer which you can use to load a sample or record into. It can load and save multichannel files.
